latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Analyzes conversation history to enhance memory management.

- Extracts user preferences and feedback from chat sessions.
- Automatically updates memory files (MEMORY.md, AGENTS.md, USER.md, IDENTITY.md, SOUL.md) with insights.
- Triggered by user feedback or preference statements.
- Uses Google Gemini 3 Flash Preview model by default.
